**PlantForAdapt - Adapting planted forests with native species for resilient Amazonian territories in the face of global changes**

PlantForAdapt is an international research collaboration between Brazil and France on native-species planted forests to support resilient Amazonian landscapes in the face of global change.

PlantForAdapt proposes an interdisciplinary scientific approach to tackle critical research priorities on planted forests in Amazonia. By placing strong emphasis on stakeholder engagement, PlantForAdapt will provide science-based guidelines to adapt management practices in tropical biodiverse planted forests to a rapidly changing context, while also contributing to cutting-edge scientific questions.

PlantForAdapt is a 4-year project (2026-2030) led by Géraldine Derroire (PI, CIRAD and University of Brasilia), Romain Lehnebach (co-PI, CIRAD), Lucas Mazzei (co-PI, Embrapa) and Sylvain Schmitt (co-PI, CIRAD and INPA). Participating institutions are [CIRAD](https://www.cirad.fr/en) (research units [Forests and Societies](https://ur-forets-societes.cirad.fr/en), [EcoFoG](https://umr-ecofog.cirad.fr/en/) and [Eco&Sols](https://www.umr-ecosols.fr/en/)), [Embrapa](https://www.embrapa.br/en), [INRAE](https://www.inrae.fr/en), [ONF](https://www.onf.fr/) ([RDI of French Guiana](https://www.onf.fr/onf/%2B/73::onf-en-guyane.html))  and its branches [ONFi](https://www.onfinternational.org/en) and [ONF Brasil](https://onfbrasil.com.br/en/), [University of French Guiana](https://www.univ-guyane.fr/en/) and [University of Brasilia](https://international.unb.br/). It is funded by the foundation [Velux Stiftung](https://veluxstiftung.ch/).
